scripts.render:machineclass: eval "$(./scripts/resolve-cluster-versions.sh unraid-lab)" && go run ./cmd/omni-render machineclass --output generated/machineclass.yaml --talos-version "$TALOS_VERSION"
scripts.render:cluster: eval "$(./scripts/resolve-cluster-versions.sh unraid-lab)" && go run ./cmd/omni-render cluster --output generated/cluster.yaml --cluster-name unraid-lab --talos-version "$TALOS_VERSION" --kubernetes-version "$KUBERNETES_VERSION"
scripts.provider:apply: omnictl apply -f omni/provider/infra-provider.yaml && go run ./cmd/omni-render provider-config --output generated/provider/libvirt-config.yaml && docker compose -f omni/provider/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env up -d
scripts.machineclass:apply: omnictl apply -f omni/machine-classes/control-plane.yaml && omnictl apply -f omni/machine-classes/worker.yaml
scripts.cluster:apply: devbox run render:cluster && omnictl cluster template validate --allowed-dir "$PWD/omni" -f generated/cluster.yaml && omnictl cluster template sync --dry-run --allowed-dir "$PWD/omni" -f generated/cluster.yaml && omnictl cluster template sync --allowed-dir "$PWD/omni" -f generated/cluster.yaml --verbose
